test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

He __borrowed__ money from his father and ________ it to his friend to help him.
solution:
Correct Answer**: 'Option 3: lent'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• **'Borrowed' **(उधार लिया) refers to take and use (something belonging to someone else) with the intention of returning it.

 
 
• **For example:** "I borrowed some sugar from my neighbor."
 
 
 
• 'Lent'
